messages:
viv: Quick sync  mini webinar tomorrow. Need a compact social cascade: X teaser, LinkedIn long-thread, 30s clip. Who owns captions + final assets?
cal: Ian do copy for both. Need MP4 clip, transcript, and a 16:9 thumbnail.
ori: Ops will export clip + transcript by 10am PT. @hana can you make thumbnails + a short GIF? deadline 11:30.
hana: Yep sizes (16:9, 1:1, 4:5) + 10s GIF. Deliver PNG + MP4. Use launch palette v3.
viv: Schedule: X 09:15 PT, LinkedIn 12:15 PT, clip follow-up +24h. Approval cutoff 08:45.
cal: Messaging: benchmark stat or customer quote? Benchmarks perform but need legal.
ori: Backup plan: anonymized stat ("~2x cost reduction") + short quote. If legal delays, remove numbers.
cal: Draft thread arriving 08:00. Plan: Hook -> pain -> anonymized result -> tactics -> CTA (rwd.in/mini).
hana: I'll create a LinkedIn hero image that's easy to swap copy on.
viv: Routing: tag signups "miniweb-2026". UTMs: source=social_x / social_li. SDRs get Slack + email.
queue-bot: Drafts queued: X (09:15 PT), LinkedIn (12:15 PT). Will publish if approvals present by 08:45 PT.
viv: Engagement plan: reply to top 5 comments within 1h, amplify best into a follow-up post. Who triages first 30m?
hana: I can triage initial replies then hand to community.
cal: Running A/B on hook (tech vs customer). Will report in 15m postmortem tomorrow 10am PT.
viv: Assets go to /shared/marketing/assets/miniweb-2026. Drop links when live.
